# Abundant Intelligence Lab

> Research led by Karan Girotra at Cornell Tech on how artificial intelligence changes the world and how to deploy and use it to create abundance for everyone.

The lab is part of Cornell Tech (Cornell University) in New York City and is led by Karan Girotra, Charles H. Dyson Family Professor of Management. It studies how AI changes work, organizations, operations and innovation, and how to deploy AI to create abundance for everyone.

## Pages

- [Lab overview (Markdown)](https://abundant-intelligence-lab.vercel.app/index.md): mission, founder, PhD students, faculty affiliates, research projects, alumni and selected work
